planning.label: Planning
planning.instructions: Clarify scope, identify risks, and produce a concrete implementation plan.

implementation.label: Implementation
implementation.instructions: Work in small commits, keep tests focused, and avoid unrelated refactors.

local_review.label: Local Review
local_review.instructions: Check the local diff, verify tests, and call out missing coverage.

pr_review.label: PR Review
pr_review.instructions: Check CI, review comments, and whether the branch is ready to merge.
